pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark contiguous regions with rounded vertices. Patch spatial area is larger on the central flank and becomes more vertically elongated toward the neck. Edges exhibit a soft pixel-level gradient with low-to-medium contrast.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological network of light pelage. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. The pathways maintain a consistent pixel thickness, providing clear separation between all observed patches on the primary flank area.
